narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Risk-Off
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multi-front conflicts (US-Iran, Israel-Hezbollah, Ukraine-Russia) escalate beyond controlled tit-for-tat, with Hormuz blockade persisting and asymmetric threats rising. The market consensus underestimates the structural nature of these escalations, driving flows into safe havens.
narratives.trade_implication: Long gold, short S&P 500 futures, long VIX, and overweight cash or short-duration Treasuries.

narratives.title: Oil Supply Disruption Premium
narratives.summary: Capital is pricing in a sustained oil supply disruption from the Hormuz blockade and SPR release being misinterpreted as bearish, while actual flows indicate structural tightness through Q3 2026. The market is underpricing the duration and severity of the blockade, with diplomatic progress unlikely to resolve it quickly.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude futures, long energy equities, and short refined product spreads to capture the structural supply premium.

narratives.title: Crypto as Macro Risk Proxy
narratives.summary: Capital is treating Bitcoin as a macro risk-off asset rather than a hedge, with the crash driven by geopolitical de-risking rather than crypto-specific fundamentals. Whales and MicroStrategy accumulation suggest dip-buying, but flows are dominated by institutional liquidation.
narratives.trade_implication: Short Bitcoin futures or long put spreads, with a tactical long on MicroStrategy equity as a contrarian play if risk-off abates.
